issues.on_page: Total transfers (76); transfer in 57,923, transfer out (57,998)

issues.on_page: Contributions and grants 338,281 (Pool 281,000, Fire 41,360, Library 15,921 on p15)
issues.issue: The Pool 281,000 and Fire 41,360 may be government grants (intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants), not private donations. This line is 22% of governmental receipts. Already marked review.
Line mixes salaries and benefits. Dominant category is fine, but there is no review note naming the mix.

issues.on_page: Cemetery Fund column; budget schedule p12 groups Cemetery under Culture and Recreation
issues.issue: The category rules put cemetery under health/welfare. The extractor followed the report's own grouping so the detail ties to the Culture and Recreation function. Defensible, but it departs from the rule.
Refuse/garbage collection is 'utilities' under the disbursement categories. The extractor used the column's function, general government. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Statement General government 181,613 and Public Safety 155,183 vs combining/budget General 201,263 and Police+Fire+Ambulance 377,503; Culture and Recreation 374,619 equal in both
issues.issue: The statement takes capital outlay 218,520 and debt 23,450 out of general government and public safety only, but Culture and Recreation still includes pool and library capital (151,999). So the detail function split cannot tie to the statement function lines. Totals agree (953,385). The extractor explains this in notes but did not add it to report_discrepancies.

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities: program revenues 338,281 + 126,885 + general revenues 1,071,259 = 1,536,425 vs funds statement total revenues 1,536,426
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities is $1 lower than the governmental funds statement (rounding; carline 932 is moved into Intergovernmental and Other taxes shows 1,547 vs 363 + 1,185 = 1,548). The JSON doesn't use these figures, but this $1 gap in the report isn't recorded.

issues.extracted: per sub-fund column (9 columns) as departments
issues.on_page: General Fund combining schedule with General, Police, Fire, Ambulance, Pool, Parks, Cemetery, Library, Tree Board, Total
issues.issue: The schedule has 9 fund columns. The extractor treated them as department columns, which is defensible because they are sub-funds of the General Fund. The combining-schedule rule says to use the Total column when there are more than 6 funds.
